content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Government SSD Higher Secondary School Nuapada Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://nuapada.odisha.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 23-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Guest Teacher posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the Guest Teacher posts is 23rd September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the Guest Teacher position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduation (Master's Degree) in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks and a B.Ed. degree. Non-B.Ed. candidates may be considered if B.Ed. qualified candidates are unavailable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying as a Guest Teacher?
faq.answer: For retired teachers, the maximum age limit is 65 years. For other eligible candidates, the maximum age limit is 62 years.

faq.question: Q4. How will the selection be made for the Guest Teacher posts?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on academic weightage (70 marks) and training weightage (30 marks). In case of a tie in total marks, preference will be given to elder candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Guest Teacher position?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 400/- per class/period, with a maximum of 40 classes/periods per month, not exceeding Rs. 16,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How should I submit my application?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted offline by sending the Bio-Data form along with self-attested copies of certificates to the District Welfare Officer, Nuapada, via Speed Post/Registered Post.

faq.question: Q7. What documents need to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: You need to attach self-attested copies of your Academic Qualification Certificates along with Mark Sheets.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Guest Teacher posts.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Government SSD Higher Secondary School Nuapada, which is https://nuapada.odisha.gov.in.
